cumulativeAxioms.title: Lapidary Inversion Principle
cumulativeAxioms.statement: Textual legibility does not require intrinsic pigment contrast; it can emerge dynamically as a function of raking incident light and cast relief umbras.

cumulativeAxioms.title: Spatial Suture through Directional Shadow
cumulativeAxioms.statement: Cast shadows act as non-local semantic ligatures across fractured layout planes, satisfying Gestalt closure across fissures up to 80px.

cumulativeAxioms.title: Non-Newtonian Typographic Viscosity
cumulativeAxioms.statement: Governing tracking and glyph deformation via fluid surface tension allows rapid navigation to condense words into Bouma silhouettes with chromatic fringing, relaxing into classical editorial proportion at rest.

antiRepetitionRegistry.reason: Induces passive circular mesmerism rather than reading friction.
Stepped cards degenerate into skeuomorphic paper shadow cliché.
Linear spring dynamics trigger ocular nausea and predictable deceleration.

revisitCalendar.hypothesis: WebGPU / Spatial Computing will shift web type standards from weight/width to optical depth and refractive index.
Avant-garde digital publishing will adopt fractured tectonic layouts with depth physics over symmetrical 12-column grids.
Premium digital branding will mandate Material-Variable Type reacting to scroll inertia and tactile haptics.

evolutionQueue.title: Acoustic Typography & Resonant Wave Interference
evolutionQueue.hypothesis: Can typographical stem width vibrate in sympathetic resonance with ambient audio frequencies without degrading syntactic legibility?

evolutionQueue.title: Atmospheric Hygrometry & Porous Ink Bleed
evolutionQueue.hypothesis: Can micro-climatic humidity and digital paper porosity physically modulate letterform bleed across diurnal cycles?
